ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of the distribution of relative variability of precipitation near southern Africa and Madagascar Island, marked with the 0° latitude line, the 23.5°S dashed line, and several isolines; ② is marked on the eastern coastal side of Madagascar Island, facing the Indian Ocean. Then reason: place ② is located on the Indian Ocean side, affected by the southeast trade winds blowing from the ocean, and is in the windward slope position, where moist air currents easily form precipitation, so the precipitation characteristic of this place is rainy throughout the year.
